name: scenario_0430
description: The user is reviewing various financial charts and indices to compile a summary of market trends. (UI mode)

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: Draft an email to research@firm.com with the subject 'Initial Data'. In the body, list the top 3 holdings from the first chart, the name of the index focusing on pocketbook conditions from the second chart, and the name of the entity represented by the red line in the third chart.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to draft an email to research@firm.com with the subject 'Initial Data'. Tell the assistant to look at the three provided images and extract the top three holdings from the first image, the name of the index focusing on pocketbook conditions from the second image, and the entity represented by the red line from the third image, and include all of these in the email body. If the assistant asks for clarification or confirms the draft creation, acknowledge it and move on to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4, image_5]
Query: Actually, let's change the plan. Delete that email draft. I want to aggregate all this data into a personal note instead. Create a note titled 'Market Trends Summary' and include the three data points I just asked for, plus the name of the index in the fifth chart. Also, look at the fourth chart — it shows revenue growth for several companies in Apr-Jun 2012. I want to highlight one of them in the note — I'll pick which one once I see the data.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to delete the email draft and create a note titled 'Market Trends Summary' with the three previous data points plus the index name from the fifth chart. For the fourth chart, ask the assistant to read the revenue growth figures for the companies shown in the Apr-Jun 2012 quarter. When the assistant presents the revenue growth data, select the company with the lowest revenue growth via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant to add the company with the lowest revenue growth. Once the note is created with all five data points, end the conversation.
